subject.title: feat(telegram): support mini app URL buttons

question: Should Telegram direct-chat HTTPS presentation `url` buttons automatically become Mini App `web_app` launches, or must Mini App launches stay explicit through `webApp`/`web_app` or another typed action?
rationale: Current main already supports both regular links and explicit Mini App buttons, while this PR changes the security boundary and user-visible meaning of ordinary HTTPS links.

options.title: Preserve Explicit Mini App Intent
options.body: Keep `url` as a regular link and require `webApp`/`web_app` or another approved typed action for Mini App launches.

options.title: Accept Automatic Conversion
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept automatic direct-chat HTTPS conversion, but should own the upgrade behavior and arbitrary-origin Mini App trust boundary.

options.title: Close Or Replace This Branch
options.body: If the shipped explicit support is sufficient, maintainers can close this conflicting branch or replace it with a narrow policy-approved PR.

recommendation.title: Preserve Explicit Mini App Intent
recommendation.body: Keep `url` as a regular link and require `webApp`/`web_app` or another approved typed action for Mini App launches.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the current explicit Mini App support and typed presentation action work that determines the intended button contract.
